about.text: Incorporated on September 29, 2005, Monomark Engineering (India) Limited is engaged in providing Industrial Operations and Maintenance (“O&M”) services, Metal Fabrication solutions and Industrial Project Execution services to industrial clients across sectors such as metals, cement, ports and engineering/OEMs. The Company’s business is organised into three segments: Industrial O&M Services, Metal Fabrication Solutions and Industrial Project Execution Services. Its O&M services include production support, plant operations, preventive and breakdown maintenance, equipment monitoring and technical support. Its metal fabrication activities involve manufacturing customised sheet metal components and structural products based on client specifications and engineering drawings. Under its project execution segment, the Company undertakes engineering, procurement and construction (“EPC”) contracts, as well as on-site fabrication, erection, installation and commissioning (“FEIC”) assignments involving heavy machinery, piping, structural steel and industrial equipment.

The Company operates a dedicated metal fabrication facility at Kapasan, Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, with an annual installed capacity of 4,000 MT. Its execution capabilities are supported by an in-house fleet of 232 industrial vehicles and equipment, including forklifts, trucks, excavators, cranes, hydra machines, bulldozers and loaders. This equipment base, together with its technical workforce, enables the Company to manage site-level logistics, mobilise resources and execute operational and project-related activities across multiple locations.

The Company serves industrial clients across the metals, ports, cement and engineering/OEM sectors, with an established client base that includes Vedanta Group, Adani Group, Aditya Birla Group, L&T Group, Tata Group, JK Lakshmi Cement Group and Shree Cement Group. It operates across seven Indian states and has an overseas subsidiary, Monomark Engineering FZE, in the United Arab Emirates, through which it provides O&M services to Fujairah Gold FZC.

As of September 30, 2026, the Company had 28 ongoing projects, comprising 21 O&M projects and 7 Industrial Project Execution projects. It reported a running unexecuted order book of ₹1,76,192.16 lakh as of the same date.
As of September 30, 2026, the Company had a total workforce of 7,608 employees, comprising 958 fixed employees and 6,650 project-specific employees.

business.text: Monomark Engineering (India) Limited provides industrial operations and maintenance (O&M) services, metal fabrication, and project execution services to industries such as metals, cement, ports, and engineering.

The company executes projects through two models: EPC, which covers complete project execution from engineering to commissioning, and FEIC, which mainly involves fabrication, erection, installation, and commissioning.

As of February, 2026, the company has 28 ongoing projects, including 20 O&M and 8 execution projects. It has completed 20 projects over the last five years and has an unexecuted order book of ₹1,09,535.03 lakhs.

The company operates a manufacturing facility in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, with offices and project sites across several states. It has a total workforce of 6,381 employees, including 836 permanent and 5,545 project-based employees.
